task.description:
BACKEND-DEV already wrote real integration/unit tests as part of Step 2a implementation (test-ddl-namespace: 10/10 unit tests; test-integration-mig01: 5/5; test-integration-mig02-mig03: 7/7). Your job: (1) write the formal test spec files tests/specs/DDL-05.md, tests/specs/MIG-01.md, tests/specs/MIG-02.md, tests/specs/MIG-03.md per test_developer_guide.md format, tracing each requirement acceptance criterion (read full bodies from docs/requirements.yaml) to the specific existing test case(s) that cover it. (2) Verify every AC actually has a covering test -- if you find a genuine gap, write the missing test case yourself in the existing test files (do not duplicate coverage that already exists). (3) Confirm no error.SkipZigTest exists on any MUST-requirement test.

REWORK 1 (routed by ORCH after RELEASE-VALIDATOR Step 5 FAIL):
- [MAJOR] MIG-02 AC4 ("GIVEN the failure-recording transaction itself fails, WHEN the fanout continues, THEN the row remains pending and the MIG-04 resume query covers it") has NO test evidence. tests/specs/MIG-02.md documented this as a deliberate deferral, claiming bpm.pool.Pool has no fault-injection hook without violating DIRECTIVE T-1. This claim is INCORRECT: Pool.init() takes a real, non-mock pool_size config parameter (minimum 2, src/db/pool.zig line ~432/448). A genuine, non-mock fault-injection test IS possible: create a Pool with pool_size=2 in the test, acquire and hold both connections open (without releasing) so the pool is genuinely exhausted, then trigger runFanout such that applyToTenant's DDL transaction fails for a tenant -- this routes into recordFailureSeparately, whose own pool.acquire() call will then genuinely fail with PoolExhausted (a real error from a real resource-exhaustion condition, not a mock), exercising logSwallowedFailure's "migration_fanout.failure_record_acquire_failed" path and proving the control row stays at its already-seeded pending status with no crash/panic and no escalation -- exactly what AC4 requires. Add this test case to tests/integration/migration_fanout_test.zig, update tests/specs/MIG-02.md's AC4 row and Coverage note to point to it instead of documenting a deferral, and re-verify zig build test-integration-mig02-mig03 passes with the new test included.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/DDL-05.md, MIG-01.md, MIG-02.md, MIG-03.md exist and trace every AC to a specific test case
Any genuine coverage gap found is closed with a new test case
No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST-requirement test
zig build test-ddl-namespace, test-integration-mig01, test-integration-mig02-mig03 all still exit 0 after any additions
